description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/VirtualAssistants/Access. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Activates, suspends or revokes one relationship without deleting products or historical authorship. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Use when: Resume accepted access, temporarily suspend or revoke it. Input: Id, current AccessVersion, AccessStatus: 2 active, 3 suspended, 4 revoked. Output: Acquiring an active slot when the account already has 3 active or invited VAs returns 409 va_profile_limit. Suspension/revocation remain available, free a slot, cancel outstanding invitations and block existing VA tokens; they do not reset email limits. Search terms: virtualassistants access. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_virtualassistants_access
title: Post Virtualassistants Access
